# Lecture Schedule

**All readings indicated are from the online textbook to be found here:**:  [http://olizardo.bol.ucla.edu/classes/soc-111/textbook/_book/](http://olizardo.bol.ucla.edu/classes/soc-111/textbook/_book/)
